judgements.justification: The authors posted no new experiments or analyses; A's rebuttal only explained Algorithm 1 and promised text, so no score rose on new results.
No high-confidence expert review exists; all seven reviewers rated 7 at confidence 2 to 3.
No late objection or score change: Gdae's post-response edit only 'heartily' recommended acceptance at 7.
Both committees rated every review 7, so no rating gap exists to reflect scoring leniency.
Only B's wyJF called the title broader than the results, and B gave the higher tier, so no overstatement verdict capped either tier.
No reviewer settled on the marginal-accept 6; all rated 7 in both committees, so B's reviewers did not commit higher.
